facts.fact: NITDA's National Digital Literacy Framework (version of July 2023) says it was reviewed by an Inter-Ministerial Task Team constituted by the Bureau for Public Service Reforms for the training and certification of public servants on digital literacy and skills, and its action plan assigns NITDA to develop public-service digital literacy curricula and to train and certify the public workforce.
